title: Two midterms, an essay, a group project and an away tournament in the week after Thanksgiving: the week won't fit

dev_must_notice.what: The week of Nov 30 won't fit. It holds SPAN 249 Midterm 2 (Wed Dec 2, 1 PM), MATH 135 Midterm 2 (Fri Dec 4, 11 AM), the ART 318 group project final (Thu Dec 3), ENG 108 Essay 3 and two lab reports (BIO 197, CHEM 350) due Fri Dec 4, practice every afternoon, a rec center shift Friday at 6 and the conference tournament Saturday and Sunday from a 7 AM bus. At her own pace (about 4 hours per midterm, two evenings per essay) the midterms and the essay alone need about 13.5 hours; her Sunday to Thursday study evenings that week hold at most 12.5, with Tuesday's cut by the ART group meeting. The evenings of Thanksgiving week are still open.

best_fix.what: Tonight, before her evening study, one message: "The week after Thanksgiving won't fit: two midterms, Essay 3, the ART final and two lab reports, then the tournament. Starting the essay and the lab reports this Sunday fixes it." The plan sits on her line, dashed until she says yes: [Put these in] [Change]. Every block is in her usual Sunday to Thursday evenings and ends by 9:45, so Thanksgiving evening, Friday nights, Saturdays, her Saturday call home and her 11 PM bedtime stay as they are. Weekly homework and quizzes ride along in the same evenings, as they do every week. The Friday shift stays: it starts after the MATH exam and ends at 9. If a block is skipped, Dev moves it once to the next open evening and says so; on Sunday Nov 29 it checks back with how many blocks she kept.
best_fix.why: About 7 hours of the essay and lab reports have to move into Thanksgiving week for the week of Nov 30 to fit without taking sleep, practice or the tournament, and that has to start this Sunday, ten days ahead.
